title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations along Granny White Pike, Hillsboro Pike, Abbott Martin Road, Lealand Lane, and 12th Avenue South, each paired with one directly sourced reason to go.

cards.title: Settle In Across the Street
cards.subtitle: Granny White Pike — a coffeehouse facing Lipscomb
cards.notes: Cross Granny White Pike for a study session, meeting, or daytime performance; check the venue directly for scheduled music.
cards.short_summary: A nearby coffeehouse with study space and a performance stage.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page places The Well at 4002 Granny White Pike across from Lipscomb University and identifies study, meeting, and performance uses.
cards.source_title: The Well Coffeehouse in Green Hills
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Monday–Friday hours of 6 a.m.–5 p.m. and weekend hours of 7 a.m.–5 p.m.; verify changes before leaving.

cards.title: Enter Radnor from the West
cards.subtitle: Granny White Pike entrance — Radnor Lake’s visitor center
cards.notes: Use the west entrance from Granny White Pike, then start with the visitor center’s restrooms and audiovisual room before exploring.
cards.short_summary: A defined west-side gateway into Radnor Lake State Natural Area.
cards.evidence_claim: Friends of Radnor Lake states that the Walter Criley Visitor Center is accessible by car from the West lot and Granny White Pike entrance.
cards.source_title: Visitor's Center | Friends of Radnor Lake
cards.access_notes: The source lists restrooms and the audiovisual room from 7 a.m. until dark; gift-shop hours are separate and the shop closes Sunday and Monday.

cards.title: Use the Outdoor Seating
cards.subtitle: Hillsboro Pike — a walkable open-air retail center
cards.notes: Head to the Hillsboro Pike center when your group needs outdoor seating and a cluster of storefronts in one mapped destination.
cards.short_summary: An open-air center with seating and multiple ways to arrive.
cards.evidence_claim: Hill Center Green Hills identifies its address as 4015–4031 Hillsboro Pike and describes the property as walkable with outdoor seating.
cards.source_title: Visitor Information - Hill Center Green Hills
cards.access_notes: The official visitor page lists street, surface-lot, and garage parking and describes the center as ADA compliant.

cards.title: Restock on Hillsboro Pike
cards.subtitle: Hillsboro Pike — the Green Hills grocery stop
cards.notes: Bring a short grocery list and use this Hillsboro Pike storefront for pantry, snack, or meal-prep supplies away from campus.
cards.short_summary: A clearly mapped grocery run in the Green Hills corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Trader Joe's official Nashville location page lists store 664 at 3909 Hillsboro Pike.
cards.access_notes: Consult the official store page for current daily hours and holiday changes before making a dedicated trip.

cards.title: Catch an In-Store Book Event
cards.subtitle: Hillsboro Pike — an independent bookstore with programming
cards.notes: Browse the store calendar before walking in; event pages specify whether an appearance is free, registered, or ticketed.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood bookstore where the calendar adds a reason to return.
cards.evidence_claim: Parnassus Books documents in-store author events at its 3900 Hillsboro Pike, Suite 14 location, including events designated free to attend.
cards.source_title: A Snow Day for Amos McGee - Philip Stead and Erin Stead
cards.access_notes: The cited event has passed; use the bookstore's current calendar to confirm upcoming event dates, registration, and admission terms.

cards.title: Combine Groceries with a Return
cards.subtitle: Hillsboro Pike — market services under one roof
cards.notes: Pair a grocery stop with an eligible Amazon return or pickup, using the store page to confirm which counter or kiosk handles it.
cards.short_summary: A market stop that can also handle eligible Amazon returns.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Green Hills store page lists 4021 Hillsboro Pike and identifies grocery services, Amazon pickup, and eligible Amazon returns.
cards.source_title: Green Hills Store | Whole Foods Market
cards.access_notes: The official page lists store hours and separate service details; confirm counter availability before bringing a return.

cards.title: Charge Up Between Errands
cards.subtitle: Abbott Martin Road — an indoor multi-store destination
cards.notes: Use the mall for an indoor errand loop, then locate its public charging stations or complimentary Wi-Fi when you need a reset.
cards.short_summary: A weather-independent stop with practical visitor amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The mall's official page places it at 2126 Abbott Martin Road and lists more than 125 stores plus complimentary Wi-Fi and public charging stations.
cards.source_title: About The Mall at Green Hills
cards.access_notes: Check the mall's official page for current center hours; individual retailer and restaurant hours may differ.

cards.title: Walk the Indoor Track
cards.subtitle: Lealand Lane at the 12 South corridor — community recreation
cards.notes: Check the current activity schedule, then use the walking track or join an age-appropriate listed program at the community center.
cards.short_summary: A public recreation anchor with indoor movement space.
cards.evidence_claim: Metro Nashville lists the center at 3021 Lealand Lane and identifies a gymnasium, upper-level walking track, dance room, fitness center, and meeting space.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists weekday and Saturday operating hours; activities, registration rules, and fees vary, so check the current schedule.

cards.title: Take an All-Day Café Break
cards.subtitle: 12th Avenue South — the original neighborhood café location
cards.notes: Use this 12th Avenue South stop for breakfast, lunch, or an afternoon café break; confirm adjusted hours before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A daytime-to-evening café option on the 12 South strip.
cards.evidence_claim: Frothy Monkey's official locations page lists its 12South café at 2509 12th Avenue South and describes the business as an all-day café and bakery.
cards.source_title: Find a Local Cafe | Frothy Monkey
cards.access_notes: The official page lists the 12South café as open daily from 7 a.m.–8 p.m. and advises checking for holiday or weather adjustments.

cards.title: Browse a Converted General Store
cards.subtitle: 12th Avenue South — a named retail stop on the corridor
cards.notes: Step into the 12th South location for a compact browse, and use the official locations page to avoid arriving after closing.
cards.short_summary: A distinct storefront for a short retail browse on 12 South.
cards.evidence_claim: White's Mercantile's official locations page identifies its 12th South store at 2400 12th Avenue South in Nashville.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Monday–Saturday hours of 10 a.m.–6 p.m. and Sunday hours of 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; verify holiday changes.
